markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (91%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second model agrees, no quality flag [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 91%, Invasive 9% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 100th percentile | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 InSitu | Moderate support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 7, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; lowers invasive term [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Score below typical, so lowers invasive term [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction 94%** (regions 1, 6, 10) · context · 100th percentile of reference; three sampled regions only [F7] · Measured
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Low score adds to invasive term; failed spot check [F2] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect +0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Case leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- A small invasive focus exists: regions 1 and 6 each carry 74% per-region invasive risk.
- The nearest reference case is Benign, and one close neighbor is Invasive.

## Check on the slide
1. **1, 6** — look for stromal invasion beyond duct walls.
2. **7, 9, 11** — confirm atypical cells stay inside ducts (concept spot check 12/20).
3. **10** — assess stroma around tumor cells for infiltration.
